segments.summary: Clarification identity, runtime/output ownership, approval-copy boundaries, context preservation, manual compaction, deterministic bundle ordering, and the acceptance-criteria truncation guard are explicit; compaction overlap and partial-failure atomicity remain underspecified.

Injected-context transparency, injector configuration/governance, model-switch repack, AGENTS promotion enforcement, and Assistant-memory eligibility are explicit; disclosure privacy and repack failure/override precedence are not.

Memory non-forwarding, canonical memory commands, retrieval separation and controls, Context Lens interaction/assembly/handoff, and BrainStorm planning are explicit; stale selection, summary failure, and rehydration recovery are not.

BrainStorm execution and projection ownership, AI-executable documentation quality, live owner deferral, historical-reference disposition, and Dashboard-to-Assistant CtA handling are explicit; auto-selection authority and natural-language action safety are not.

HITL handoff, canonical dev actions and output projection, consequence disclosure, multi-terminal identity, surface reveal, pane reconciliation, history preservation, and project-switch recalculation are explicit; close-choice recovery and history data lifecycle are not.

No-silent-orphan safety, adopted gap scope, file-reference visibility, revert/rewind separation, owner boundaries, FIFO queueing, repack resolution, thought-stream unification, and crew plan normalization are explicit; close/revert atomicity and queue race behavior remain open.

ELI5 prompt restraint, long-thread mitigation, competitive and MVP scope, command lifecycle, queue/error UX, platform/input behavior, HITL notifications, and concurrency ownership are explicit; destructive command safeguards, notification privacy, accessibility/localization, and concurrency enforcement are not.

Per-thread plan/error scope, non-blanket traceability, Git ownership, and Slint long-thread virtualization/streaming/lazy-rendering constraints are explicit; accessibility is explicitly excluded and performance/privacy acceptance oracles remain incomplete.
